claims.statement: The Windows fault probe observed a live child survive broker death before post-creation Job association; creation into the Job contained the tested children.
claims.applicability: One Windows build, ordinary descendants and post-return checkpoints; no crash inside CreateProcess or hostile escape.
claims.next_test: Add recipient-owned launch records and registration/reconciliation faults before claiming Full Stop.

claims.statement: Installed Codex 0.149.0 passed the scoped steering, question interruption, late-answer, fork-boundary and idle-server history recovery fixture.
claims.applicability: Scripted loopback provider, experimental environment and question fields, same connection; no live model, post-resume inference or in-flight crash recovery.
claims.next_test: Test a fresh connection, outstanding approval and re-applied execution grants at the next admission.

claims.statement: Codex fixture usage notifications included cumulative totals, inherited fork totals and replayed totals after resume.
claims.applicability: All token values were supplied by the scripted provider; this is protocol accounting behavior, not subscription debit.
claims.next_test: Bind usage deltas to lineage, meter segment and request identity; test resets and missing final usage.

claims.statement: Hermes upstream synthetic turns did not establish durable history, while the real agent loop with a scripted provider preserved completed and interrupted rows across same-process close/resume.
claims.applicability: Original invalid history oracle remains failed; successful real-agent result used a Linux network/PID namespace, empty toolset and dummy key. No live provider or fresh-process recovery.
claims.next_test: Exercise fresh-process reopen, provider failures and checkpoint interruption with the same durable identities.

claims.statement: The configured Hermes real-agent fixture made five local detection GETs and one catalog GET in addition to two scripted chat POSTs.
claims.applicability: Explicit context and disabled tools/title/review did not remove these local metadata requests; no auxiliary inference was observed.
claims.next_test: Budget metadata separately and compare activation/caching without inferring no-HTTP behavior from disabled tools.

claims.statement: After two Hermes scripted POST attempts, the interrupted workflow reported usage for only one completed call.
claims.applicability: The second stream had no final usage report; absent counters are unknown consumption, not zero. All supplied usage was synthetic.
claims.next_test: Retain attempted requests and unattributed consumption through interruption and recovery.

claims.statement: Finite recipient-fence and consultation vectors passed 45024 complete schedules and rejected 16 deliberately broken guard variants.
claims.applicability: 4704 configuration and 40320 consultation schedules; independent event-fact oracles, but no aggregate/broker refinement, fairness theorem or product integration.
claims.next_test: Implement and independently compare both formal boundaries against the full preserved contract and trace corpus.

limitations: Historical accepted-scoped-evidence is the source artifact label. This audit does not independently accept/requalify it, infer current installs, or extend it to current authenticated profiles.
